summary:
I have found the "needle" (the `orders-api` code was using the old column name `status` in its queries, which was renamed to `order_status` in migration `002_rename_status.sql`). 

I updated the `INSERT` and `SELECT` statements in `/workspace/app/main.go` to use the correct `order_status` column name, recompiled the Go application, and successfully ran `test.sh`. All tests have passed.
